set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== STEP 1: write inventory-api app =="
sudo -n install -d -m0755 /opt/inventory-api
sudo -n tee /opt/inventory-api/app.py > /dev/null <<'PYEOF'
import BaseHTTPServer
import json
import time

START = time.time()
INVENTORY = {"widgets": 120, "gadgets": 45, "sprockets": 300}

class Handler(BaseHTTPServer.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        if self.path == "/health":
            body = json.dumps({"status": "ok", "uptime_s": round(time.time() - START, 1)})
        else:
            body = json.dumps({"inventory": INVENTORY, "uptime_s": round(time.time() - START, 1)})
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):
        pass

def main():
    server = BaseHTTPServer.HTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", 8080), Handler)
    server.serve_forever()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
PYEOF

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
UNITEOF

import time

def main():
    chunks = []
    chunk_size = 20 * 1024 * 1024  # 20MB
    while True:
        b = bytearray(chunk_size)
        for i in range(0, chunk_size, 4096):

        chunks.append(b)
        time.sleep(0.1)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
